messages.text: Hi, I returned the cordless screwdriver. Please send the refund to my new card, the old one was cancelled.

I found your returned cordless screwdriver. I can’t send its refund to a new card: refunds must go to the original payment, even if the card was cancelled. The card issuer handles the credit, and the shop cannot promise where or when it appears (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Would you like to proceed with a refund to the original payment?
